args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Per runbook, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. Rollback verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 release before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified afterwards: healthy everywhere, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident notes recommend root-causing v2.3.1 before attempting any redeploy.
